impact: Supports GOOGL's in-house AI chip story and adds competitive pressure on Nvidia; positive for your GOOGL position.
summary: Alphabet rose about 3.3% in morning trading to around $294 after Google launched two new tensor processing unit variants. JPMorgan removed it from its focus list but kept Overweight. The stock is still well below its 52-week high of $408.61.
title: Alphabet rises 3.3% as Google launches two new TPU variants
